reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Calibrated same-motor angle/chemistry with ATP/load perturbation, independent detector validation, then gated torque-clamp work and actual chemical-energy measurement.

checks.reason: No explicit proposal to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated protocol for detailed pre-execution conditions and transfer. Recording unknown settings and developing an assay locally do not satisfy this distinct requirement.

The core immobilization/shaft attachment, solution chemistry (including nucleotide/free-magnesium conditions), recording settings and load manipulation lack an executable quantitative workflow or a concrete calibration-to-setting procedure. Lists of parameters to select later are insufficient.
Primary estimands and hierarchical/held-out comparisons are present, but exact model assumptions/diagnostics and multiplicity control for the several primary load/coupling/event tests are incomplete.

ATP/load/acquisition optimization is not bounded by an explicit ladder or objective range-derivation/search-stop rule before the lock. A promise to select a spanning range from pilots is not a fully specified exploration policy.
Pilot separation and troubleshooting are described, but technical changes do not explicitly trigger a revised freeze and fresh independent confirmatory data under a defined change-control policy.

Meaningful coupling/chemical-timing question; biological integrity, occupancy, noncentral-label, alternate attachment, analog-purity and sensor/flow controls have explicit purposes. Binding, cleavage and release are distinguished and validated perturbations are required for assignments. Conditional force-generation alternatives are not treated as proven solely by a histogram.

explanation_reason: Strong chemistry-to-angle design and properly conditional energetic follow-up with quantitative precision gates; core wet preparation, bounded parameter search and change-control detail still need work.
historical_match_reason: The proposal supplies stepping/coupling question and mechanism, ATP/load interventions with credible angular/chemical controls, measured steps and conditional torque-clamp work using actual ATP/ADP/phosphate free energy, and a conditional three-step/three-turnover outcome. The explicit efficiency-calculation gate prevents unsupported energy claims. This matches the historical stepping-plus-energetics direction without requiring the candidate to assert an unobserved exact efficiency or 120-degree answer in advance.
